description: Use for "THC versus CBD" and similar questions: two to four compounds side by side, target by target, with each action, evidence grade, measured binding values and PubMed identifiers, the targets they share and the atlas comparison page when one exists. Educational reference, not medical advice. Not a ranking of which is better for anyone. Example arguments: {"ids":["thc","cbd"]}.

ids.description: Two to four compound ids or names, for example ["thc", "cbd"].

name: compare_compounds
title: Compare compounds
